description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquired land in the Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, specifically providing notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation deposits for acquired lands. The document contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their locations, lot numbers, extents, and compensation details. This falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property-related administrative procedures.
